content.value_statement: Uploading files through the Google Workspace CLI can require exact flags and careful confirmation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code to upload local files to Google Drive with folder and filename options.
actual_capabilities: Guides uploads of a local file to Google Drive.
Supports choosing a parent Drive folder by folder ID.
Supports setting a target filename during upload.
Uses automatic MIME type detection from the gws CLI.
Reminds the assistant to confirm before running the write command.
limitations: Requires the gws CLI and Google Workspace authentication.
Uploads one local file per command.
Does not manage folder permissions or sharing settings.
Does not replace user approval for sensitive file uploads.

use_cases.title: Upload a business document
use_cases.description: Send a local PDF or office file to Google Drive after confirming the source path and destination.

use_cases.title: Place files in a shared folder
use_cases.description: Upload a file directly into a known Drive folder using its folder ID.

use_cases.title: Standardize uploaded filenames
use_cases.description: Rename a local file during upload so the Drive copy follows team naming rules.

prompt_templates.title: Upload a single file
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload ./report.pdf to Google Drive. Confirm the source file with me before running the write command.

prompt_templates.title: Upload to a folder
prompt_templates.scenario: Use a known Drive folder ID
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload ./report.pdf to Google Drive folder FOLDER_ID. Show the planned upload details and ask for confirmation first.

prompt_templates.title: Upload with a new name
prompt_templates.scenario: Set the Drive filename during upload
prompt_templates.prompt: Upload ./data.csv to folder FOLDER_ID as Sales Data.csv. Confirm the source path, target name, and folder before execution.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare multiple uploads
prompt_templates.scenario: Plan several upload commands before approval
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare upload steps for these local files and target Drive names. Do not run any upload until I approve each file.

output_examples.output: I will upload report.pdf from the current directory to Google Drive. I will ask for confirmation before running the write command.

output_examples.input: Upload data.csv to folder FOLDER_ID as Sales Data.csv.
output_examples.output: The upload plan uses data.csv as the source file, the provided folder as the destination, and Sales Data.csv as the Drive filename.

output_examples.input: Help me upload a file, but I am not sure which folder to use.
output_examples.output: I will ask for the target folder or use the default Drive location only after you confirm that choice.

best_practices: Confirm the exact source file before every upload.
Verify the destination folder ID before using the parent option.
Use a clear target filename when the local filename is unclear.
anti_patterns: Do not upload sensitive files without explicit approval.
Do not assume a parent folder when the user has not provided one.
Do not run the upload if the local path is ambiguous or missing.

faq.question: What does this skill upload?
faq.answer: It uploads a local file to Google Drive using the Google Workspace CLI.

faq.question: Can it choose a Drive folder?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a parent folder ID to upload the file into that folder.

faq.question: Can it rename the file during upload?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide a target filename to use a different name in Google Drive.

faq.question: Does it detect the MIME type?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented workflow says MIME type is detected automatically.

faq.question: Does it require confirmation?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill warns that upload is a write command and requires user confirmation before execution.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code when the gws CLI is available.
